So, there was no need for me to help her look for them. That makes sense because if she already has her keys, there's no problem to solve. Another angle is the effort I put in. I usually make an effort to help, which is commendable. But today, since there was no issue, my inaction wasn't a lack of effort but rather a recognition of the situation. It's about being efficient and not overstepping when it's unnecessary. I also consider how she might feel about this. If she's aware that I help her when she needs it, she might understand that today wasn't one of those times.
